elements.requirement: So far as is reasonably practicable, every person who is eligible to vote by postal voting must have a voting paper sent to them by post at their home address or another address which they have requested the trade union in writing to treat as their postal address.
elements.quote: So far as is reasonably practicable, every person who is eligible to vote by postal voting must have a voting paper sent to them by post at their home address or another address which they have requested the trade union in writing to treat as their postal address.

elements.requirement: Each voting paper must state the name of the independent scrutineer.
elements.quote: state the name of the independent scrutineer

elements.requirement: Each voting paper must clearly specify the address to which, and the date by which, it is to be returned.
elements.quote: clearly specify the address to which, and the date by which, it is to be returned

elements.requirement: Each voting paper must be given one of a series of consecutive whole numbers, every one of which is used in giving a different number in that series to each voting paper printed or otherwise produced for the purposes of the ballot.
elements.quote: be given one of a series of consecutive whole numbers every one of which is used in giving a different number in that series to each voting paper printed or otherwise produced for the purposes of the ballot

elements.requirement: Each voting paper must be marked with its number.
elements.quote: be marked with its number.

elements.requirement: Where a person chooses to vote by postal voting, that person votes by marking the voting paper sent to them.
elements.quote: Where a person chooses to vote by postal voting, the person votes by marking the voting paper sent to them.

elements.requirement: A voting paper sent or otherwise provided to a person for voting must not have any other document enclosed with it, except for permitted statutory enclosures.
elements.quote: A voting paper which is sent or otherwise provided to a person for voting must not have enclosed with it any other document except—

elements.requirement: A voting paper sent or otherwise provided to a person for voting may have enclosed with it the notice which, under section 99(1), is to accompany the voting paper.
elements.quote: the notice which, under section 99(1), is to accompany the voting paper

elements.requirement: A voting paper sent or otherwise provided to a person for voting may have enclosed with it an addressed envelope.
elements.quote: an addressed envelope

elements.requirement: A voting paper sent or otherwise provided to a person for voting may have enclosed with it a document containing instructions for the return of the voting paper.
elements.quote: a document containing instructions for the return of the voting paper

elements.requirement: A voting paper sent or otherwise provided to a person for voting may have enclosed with it the provision required to be sent with the voting materials under section 100CA(2)(c), without any other statement.
elements.quote: the provision required to be sent with the voting materials under section 100CA(2)(c), without any other statement.
